null_subspace.affects: SM Fig-S3 LEFT and CENTER scree bars k = 0, 1 only
null_subspace.finding: every panel sample carries n_null GEVP modes at lambda <= TAU_POS.  Those eigenvalues are DEGENERATE, so the eigenvector basis inside the null subspace -- and hence the split of the spectral weight q_k between scree bar 0 and scree bar 1 -- is LAPACK-build dependent and is NOT a reproducible number.  The null subspace's TOTAL weight and every positive mode ARE reproducible.  This is a property of the published construction, exposed by re-running it; it is disclosed, not repaired.

qk_provenance.quote: npred2 = einsum('ia,ab,ib->i', W55, S55, W55); c_pred = einsum('iak,ia->ik', VP, W55 @ S55); qk = c_pred**2 / maximum(npred2, 1e-16)[:, None]
